---
title: "Customized scenario & probability"
guide-section: "DSA & analysis"
---

`lic_dsf.scenario` is a **namespace for two Excel tools**, not one engine:

| Tool | Excel | Module |
|------|-------|--------|
| **Customized Scenario** | Customized Scenario – public/external | `scenario.customized` |
| **Probability approach** | Probability approach / **Output 6** | `scenario.probability` |

They share almost no code. Stress tailored A2 may consume
`CustomizedScenarioSpec`; that does not fold probability into stress.
Output 6 DataFrames live in `lic_dsf.output`. Input 8 SDR remains in Ext
via books / `pv`.

## Customized Scenario

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `CustomizedScenarioSpec` | Named custom path deltas / levels |
| `apply_customized_deltas` | Apply deltas to a baseline series |
| `register_custom_path` | Push a path into `ChartDataRegistry` |

```python
from lic_dsf.rating import ChartDataRegistry
from lic_dsf.scenario import CustomizedScenarioSpec, register_custom_path

registry = ChartDataRegistry()
# Build or load a custom PV/GDP (etc.) path, then:
# register_custom_path(registry, ...)
```

## Probability approach (Output 6)

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `ProbabilityAssumptions` | Borderline bandwidth (and simple Φ helper) |
| `DistressCovariates` / `distress_probability` | Excel `NORMDIST` regression (CPIA, growth, …) |
| `load_distress_covariates` (`lic_dsf.load`) | Input 3 + Imported data `H77:H81` averages |
| `breach_probability` / `path_breach_probabilities` | Simple path vs threshold Φ |
| `probability_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Output 6-shaped probability summary |
| `borderline_bands` | Near-threshold bands |

```python
from lic_dsf.load import load_distress_covariates
from lic_dsf.output import probability_panel
from lic_dsf.scenario import ProbabilityAssumptions

# probability_panel(..., covariates=load_distress_covariates(workbook))
```

Full wiring with baseline/stress books is in
[`demo/output_6.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_6.ipynb).

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| User-defined shock / path | Customized Scenario |
| Probability of distress | Output 6 / Probability approach `NORMDIST` |
| Most-extreme shock path | Chart Data `D63` (`lic_dsf.rating.most_extreme_shock_id`) |
| Historical scenario | `A1_historical_ext` |
